cobblemon.ability.vendetta.desc: Powers up the Pokémon's supereffective attacks even further.
cobblemon.ability.frigidfrenzy.desc: In snow or hail, the Pokémon's Atk and Spe stat is boosted, but its HP decreases every turn.
cobblemon.ability.borealwings.desc: Gives priority to the Pokémon's Ice-type moves.
cobblemon.ability.scorchingwings.desc: The Pokémon's attacks become critical hits if the target is burned.
cobblemon.ability.stormwings.desc: The Pokémon makes it rain when it enters a battle, and draws in all Electric attacks to boost it's Sp. Atk stat.
cobblemon.ability.corona.desc: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Water-type moves. Contact with the Pokémon may burn the attacker.
cobblemon.ability.hopeless.desc: The Pokémon is immune to Fairy-type moves.
cobblemon.move.swiftsting.desc: The user lunges at the target, swiftly attacking them with their stinger. This move always goes first.
cobblemon.move.sneakattack.desc: The user sneaks up and swiftly strikes the target. This move always goes first.
cobblemon.move.dragondash.desc: The user dashes and strikes the target with draconic energy. This move always goes first.
cobblemon.move.voltjolt.desc: The user quickly tackles and jolts the target. This move always goes first.
cobblemon.move.dazzledash.desc: The user dashes and dazzles the target with mystical energy. This move always goes first.
cobblemon.move.steelblade.desc: The user slices the target with a blade as sharp as steel. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
cobblemon.move.choppingblock.desc: The user slashes the opponent with an Axe-like blade. This move has a heightened critical hit chance, and is unaffected by the target’s stats.
cobblemon.move.skystrike.desc: The user soars and clashes with the target at blinding speed. This move always goes first.
cobblemon.move.boulderbash.desc: The user bashes the target with rough chunks of rock.
cobblemon.move.drakeglide.desc: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
cobblemon.move.clearcoat.desc: The user shrouds it's frame in a clear coating. This boosts its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.
cobblemon.move.dustscrape.desc: The user ravages the target with it's savage fins. If hit, a Sandstorm is summoned on the field.
cobblemon.move.wickedbarrage.desc: The user unleashes a barrage of power from it's three heads. This move always lands a critical hit.
cobblemon.move.droopyhaze.desc: The user attacks by clouding the target in a mucky mist. This attack clears all stat changes after use.
